loss_rule: GT visible and (nonfinite prediction or predicted invisible or EPE > threshold); first observed labeled failure, not inferred onset
localization_denominator: all reviewed unambiguous GT-visible active point frames; nonfinite predictions count incorrect in threshold rates
epe_policy: finite coordinates regardless of predicted visibility; missing predictions reported separately
visibility_denominator: all reviewed unambiguous active entries with resolved visibility
gt_rule: human visual annotation and review plus confirmed query-material correspondence; no model-assisted labels/interpolation
identity_rule: human case review tied to result configuration; geometric proximity alone is insufficient
